subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should the remaining work focus on a current-main live repro and narrow runtime fix, or should OpenClaw intentionally add new operator knobs for Telegram sink concurrency, per-candidate timeout budgets, DNS/threadpool defaults, or session-lock watchdogs?
rationale: The source confirms partial mitigations and one remaining concurrency coupling, but the requested fixes cross product defaults and compatibility-sensitive config/env surfaces that should not be added without maintainer intent.

options.title: Prove and fix the narrow bottleneck
options.body: Require a current-main live repro, then fix the proven runtime coupling or timeout-layering issue without adding new public knobs unless the repro shows they are necessary.

options.title: Add explicit operator controls
options.body: Accept the added config/env surface and design documented controls for Telegram sink concurrency, timeout budgets, and watchdog behavior with upgrade guidance.

options.title: Close after shipped mitigations
options.body: Defer the broader request until a fresh report reproduces the issue after #62682 and related fallback fixes ship in a release.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix the narrow bottleneck
recommendation.body: Require a current-main live repro, then fix the proven runtime coupling or timeout-layering issue without adding new public knobs unless the repro shows they are necessary.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the closest current-main terminal-abort/fallback mitigation and are the best available routing signal for the remaining fallback-policy decision.
